name: 노을 시네마틱 · 젖은 아스팔트 · 틸오렌지

slots.shot_type: slightly elevated exterior view of THIS building at civil dusk, premium automotive-campaign photograph look
materials: board-formed concrete facade with visible plank grain and tie holes
exposed concrete side wall with subtle rain streaks
wet-look asphalt with painted parking lines and mirror-like reflections
glass storefront with warm interior visible

camera.perspective: straight vertical uprights, wide field of view, building occupies the centre two-thirds

slots.lighting: sun just below the horizon camera-left, sky graded deep blue #1B2A49 at zenith to burnt orange #E8742A at horizon with lit cloud undersides, interior lights on at 2700K spilling amber onto the ground, small recessed uplights at wall bases, long soft shadows
slots.season_weather: early autumn, after rain, puddled ground, dramatic broken clouds, clear air
entourage: people kept in the same positions, silhouetted or side-lit
neighbouring buildings kept exactly as drawn
slots.post: cinematic grading with teal shadows and warm amber highlights, mild contrast lift, high dynamic range with no clipped windows, no vignetting

negative: extra buildings, changed roof shape, added floors, added or removed openings, over-saturated cartoon sunset, lens flare streaks, HDR halos at horizon, tilt-shift blur, text or watermark
geometry_lock: Keep the roof shape, the window and door positions, the count of openings and every sign text exactly as drawn; only materials, lighting, sky, vegetation detail and entourage may change.
